system.description:
You will not be [Confused]. [Trigger: Action] Use at the same time as your "Heal". Add +[your recovery power] to the next damage roll made by the target of "Heal" (this effect is treated as CS and is canceled once the effect is activated). Can be used once per scene.

A ceremonial hat said to have been used by God's apostles. Its magical power, which is a symbol of deep faith, imparts the effect of elevating the spirit of the opponent to the healing power exercised by the wearer.

Radiant Crystal [Core Material] (50G) + Willow Band (60G) + Black Ring (90G) + [Magic Catalyst 4] (30G) x 4 + Crafting Cost (120G)
